entries.name: Ruby Doris Smith Robinson

expected.charges: Breach of the peace — Freedom Ride arrival at the Jackson Trailways terminal, June 2, 1961.
expected.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record
expected.sentence: Arrested 1961-06-02. The Civil Rights Digital Library establishes the arrest and the identification photograph but not the disposition, any transfer to Parchman, or the release date — unresolved pending court, jail, or penitentiary records.

updates.sentence: Served a documented 45-day jail term following the 1961 Freedom Ride arrest, including confinement at Parchman Penitentiary. The exact release date remains unverified.

entries.rationale: SNCC Digital Gateway and the Atlanta University Center archival collection biography identify an actual 45-day jail term. Record documented time served without calculating an unsupported release date.
